data.body:
Progress 2026-11-11 PST: plan review round 3 PASSed (0 blocking, 18 advisory). Claimed. Implemented in worktree engine-switch, branch agentic-engine, local commit eb7811f60e1; make verify next.

Advisories acted on during implementation: (a) tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json refreshed for RunRequest.read_only (gen_api_surface.py --update); (b) prerequisites rendered with the canonical prerequisites.render_blocks; (c) criteria context keeps only named, non-DET entries (drops P1-P11 and the nameless prerequisite-consistency); (d) the verdict op's OUTPUT is the existing plan_review_verdict schema, like plan_review_coach/passthrough, so only its input contract is new (3 schema files, not 4); (e) the verdict's `model` names the frontier class the agent ran on; (f) docs/config.md says an agentic review is an unsigned INDETERMINATE until the adapter lands.

Advisories recorded, not changed: the budget reads ADR 0123's "80 iterations" as 80 model requests (iteration_limit 156 → ceil(156/2)+2 = 80); the ADR names iteration_limit=80 by field, which in rebar's units would cap at 42 requests, below the 60-step steering point. iteration_limit only lowers the budget, so an operator max_iterations below 156 lowers it further. The parent's "criteria as context" is rendered as id/name lines, not full `rebar explain` text. The tail is engine-gated, so under "agentic" a floor BLOCK with 2+ DET blockers skips fix-unit grouping (stamps only; verdict and findings identical).
